items.title: Add meta prompts for agent/skill/prompt creation

items.title: Port key agents into AGENTS.md format
acceptance: agents/multi-ai/AGENTS.md, agents/dispatcher/AGENTS.md, agents/meta-agent/AGENTS.md exist

items.title: Add helper scripts for memory and learning flows
acceptance: scripts/youtube-transcript.py exists or a documented alternative is provided
scripts/memory_read.py and scripts/memory_write.py exist or documented alternatives are provided

items.title: Update setup scripts to install skills and helpers
acceptance: scripts/setup-global.sh installs .codex/skills into ~/.codex/neural-codex and ~/.codex/skills
scripts/setup-project.sh seeds .codex/skills into a project
Existing setup behavior preserved

items.title: Document prompts, skills, and setup
acceptance: README-neural-codex.md (or README.md) lists prompts, skills, and loop usage
